descriptors_PCA: Quantized uint8 viewing outputs using np.rint(clip((raw+1)*127.5,0,255)); frozen descriptors and class means/scales/PC1 unchanged.
rgb_rms: Raw generated float mapped to [0,1], compared with source uint8/255, RMS over all RGB channels/pixels.
nearest_target_rms: Raw generated float mapped to [0,1], minimum RMS to each same-class D1 optimization uint8/255 image.
edge_change: Difference in frozen neighbor_gradient descriptor on quantized viewing output versus source.
tails: Eight largest raw-float source/output RGB RMS among D0_to_D1 translations, ties direction then source path. Identity controls excluded from tail-selection population.
